options.text: Please acknowledge receipt of the contract by Friday.
Please acknowledge the contract to my desk by Friday.
Please acknowledge the contract into the archive.
Please acknowledge the contract for two more weeks.

explanation: acknowledge receipt of something 是商務書信中確認收到的固定用語。

distractorExplanations.b: 送到某處要用 send 或 deliver。
distractorExplanations.c: 歸檔要用 file 或 archive。

options.text: We implemented the feature last week but have not deployed it yet.
We implemented the feature to production last Friday.
We implemented the meeting until next Tuesday.
We implemented an idea that nobody has designed yet.

explanation: implement 是「寫出來、做出來」，deploy 才是「送上線」。選項 A 正確地區分了兩者。

distractorExplanations.b: 送上正式環境要用 deployed 或 released。
distractorExplanations.d: implement 的前提是已經有可執行的設計；還沒設計就無從實作。

options.text: The guide gives comprehensive coverage of every public endpoint.
She is very comprehensive when she reviews code.
The explanation was comprehensive enough for me to understand it.
He speaks comprehensive English with a clear accent.

explanation: comprehensive 描述「涵蓋範圍完整」，修飾 coverage 是最典型的用法。

distractorExplanations.b: 形容人做事仔細要用 thorough；comprehensive 不形容人。
distractorExplanations.c: 這裡想說的是「看得懂」，應該用 comprehensible。
distractorExplanations.d: 英文說得好要用 fluent 或 clear，不用 comprehensive。

options.text: The sample is biased towards power users.
The sample is bias towards power users.
The sample is biasing towards power users.
The sample has bias of power users.

explanation: bias 是名詞，形容詞是 biased。描述樣本偏向某群體要用 is biased towards。

distractorExplanations.b: bias 是名詞，不能直接放在 be 動詞後當形容詞。
distractorExplanations.c: bias 作動詞時是及物的，這裡的進行式用法不成立。
distractorExplanations.d: 介系詞錯誤，應為 a bias towards power users。

options.text: The retry storm exacerbated an outage that would otherwise have been brief.
The new caching layer exacerbated our response times.
The training exacerbated the team's confidence.
We exacerbated the release to next week.

explanation: exacerbate 的受詞必須是本來就存在的負面事物，outage 正是如此。

distractorExplanations.b: 若快取讓回應時間變好，應該用 improved；exacerbate 只能讓壞事更壞。
distractorExplanations.c: confidence 是正面事物，提升應該用 boosted。

options.text: Beyond four replicas the marginal benefit is close to zero.
The outage had a marginal impact that took down every region.
She wrote a marginal report of two hundred pages.
The team was marginal about the decision.

explanation: marginal benefit（邊際效益）是標準用法，指「再多做一單位所增加的效益」。

distractorExplanations.b: 句子自相矛盾：影響若能拖垮所有區域，就絕非 marginal。
distractorExplanations.c: marginal 不用來描述文件長度。
distractorExplanations.d: 形容人態度猶豫要用 ambivalent 或 undecided。

prompt: In which sentence does "redundant" carry a positive meaning?

options.text: Each critical path has a redundant instance in another region.
The comment is redundant; it just restates the function name.
Two layers run the same validation, so one check is redundant.
The paragraph is redundant and should be deleted.

explanation: 在系統設計中，刻意的重複（備援）是為了提高可靠性，因此是正面的。其餘三句都是「無謂重複」的負面用法。

distractorExplanations.b: 註解重複函式名稱是浪費，屬於負面用法。
distractorExplanations.c: 兩層做同樣驗證是無謂重複，屬於負面用法。
distractorExplanations.d: 段落重複應該刪除，屬於負面用法。

options.text: The result is counter-intuitive: adding threads made the job slower.
The result is counter-intuitive: adding threads made the job faster.
The button is counter-intuitive because it is bright red.
She is counter-intuitive and always trusts the data.

explanation: counter-intuitive 表示「與一般預期相反」。多數人預期加執行緒會變快，結果變慢，正符合。

distractorExplanations.b: 加執行緒變快正是一般人的預期，並不反直覺。
distractorExplanations.c: 顏色鮮豔只是顯眼，與是否符合預期無關。
distractorExplanations.d: counter-intuitive 描述結果或設計，不用來形容人的性格。

options.text: The summary obfuscates the cause instead of naming it.
The summary obfuscates the cause so everyone finally understood.
She obfuscated the room before the presentation.
He obfuscated to the meeting ten minutes late.

explanation: obfuscate 是「刻意弄得讓人看不懂」，與 instead of naming it 的批評語氣完全吻合。

distractorExplanations.b: 句子自相矛盾：obfuscate 使人更難懂，不會讓大家終於理解。
distractorExplanations.c: obfuscate 的受詞是語言或程式碼，不是實體空間。
distractorExplanations.d: obfuscate 是及物動詞，也不表示遲到。

options.text: The test results were equivocal: the confidence interval spans zero.
The test results were equivocal and settled the debate for good.
The equivocal server returned a 500 error.
She gave an equivocal answer of exactly forty-two.

explanation: equivocal 表示「無法下定論」，信賴區間跨越零正是統計上無定論的典型情況。

distractorExplanations.b: 無法下定論的結果不可能一舉終結辯論，句子自相矛盾。
distractorExplanations.c: 伺服器故障不是「模稜兩可」，這個字不修飾機器狀態。
distractorExplanations.d: 給出精確數字正是明確的答案，與 equivocal 相反。
